supplied_metadata.description: This note deduces a sharp Cartier-index criterion for irreducible normal projective complex klt Fano varieties of positive dimension carrying a weak Kahler–Einstein metric with bounded potentials: an ample Cartier root -K_X = rL with r > dim(X)/2 + 1 forces stable tangent sheaves on finite quasi-etale covers and rigidity of parallel orthogonal complex structures up to sign. The criterion combines the decomposition theorem of Druel–Guenancia–Paun, a Hilbert-polynomial index bound, and local positive-Ricci curvature; products of equal-dimensional projective spaces show that the strict threshold is sharp. For cubic n-folds with n at least 5, the note applies the criterion to identify all fibers of the forgetful map from complex-preserving GH moduli to ordinary metric GH moduli as conjugation orbits, including singular boundary points. This cubic application uses as an external input OpenAI's ordinary-double-point upper gap theorem at repository commit adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a; that theorem is not reproved here. The complex-preserving cubic GH/GIT comparison is an attributed deduction through Li–Liu's global Reeb minimum and Spotti–Sun's established transfer. Kong–Shen–Zhao–Zhao already publicly state a stronger complex algebraic comparison. Smooth tangent stability, smooth metric rigidity, and the conjugation convention are credited to Peternell–Wisniewski, Spotti, and Odaka–Spotti–Sun. No first-solution claim, scheme or stack comparison, or formal verification is made. The downloadable files are the paper PDF and an archive of original source, verification scripts, scoped audits, and provenance records; third-party manuscripts and reading caches are excluded. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting, and verification. Internal adversarial AI reviews are not conventional human peer review; this preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review. Original manuscript and prose are licensed CC BY 4.0; original code is additionally available under the MIT license as specified in the source archive.
supplied_metadata.title: Metric rigidity at the boundary of cubic compactifications
